subject: Request for additional pilot runway after integration sprint slip
messages:
From: Aiden Cole <aiden@tessera.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Rachel Ng <rachel@tessera.ai>, procurement@tessera.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline impact — request for short bridge and credits

Hey Jordan,

Quick note from our side — engineering ran into a blocker with the SAML adapter during last week's staging pass. Rachel's team attached the trace (integration-log-20261022.txt) and we discovered a compatibility regression that will take two more sprints to resolve.

Given the delay, we'd like to ask for two things:
- A 30-day trial extension for our pilot (we're in the middle of the proof-of-concept)
- A modest sandbox top-up (runway credits) so we can finish the connector testing without interruptions

We love Redwood's runtime performance — this is just a timing issue on our side. Can you advise next steps and whether your team can approve an extension + credits for Tessera Labs? Procurement is on cc for confirmation.

Thanks,
Aiden Cole
Head of Platform Integrations
Tessera Labs
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Aiden Cole <aiden@tessera.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, elliot_price@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@tessera.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — request for short bridge and credits

Aiden — thanks for the detail and for the attachment. I reviewed the log briefly. Appreciate the heads-up.

Short answers: we can do a 30-day extension (no problem) and we typically approve a small sandbox credit top-up for integration blockers while engineering works through a fix. Before I sign off: could you confirm the expected ETA from your engineering lead and whether any additional production data will be used in the sandbox? That helps Marissa scope support and the security/compliance checks.

Elliot — tagging you to confirm if 4 weeks looks right for this class of adapter regression.
Marissa — I copied you for the credit amount guidance and any compliance flags.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rachel replies with a short ETA and confirms data scope
2) Elliot confirms the expected dev effort and whether we should provision a temporary test cluster
3) I can approve the extension + up to $1,500 in sandbox credits once we have those details (if procurement ok)

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jordanblake

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Aiden Cole <aiden@tessera.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — request for short bridge and credits

On Tue, Oct 27, 2026 at 11:03 AM jordan_blake@redwood.ai wrote:
> Aiden — thanks for the detail and for the attachment. I reviewed the log briefly. Appreciate the heads-up.
> 
> Elliot — tagging you to confirm if 4 weeks looks right for this class of adapter regression.

Hi all — read the log and chatted with our infra team. Two quick technical notes:
- The SAML regression is reproducible with the current adapter shim; root cause is an unexpected assertion attribute change from the IdP.
- Fix requires an update to the adapter + 2 small E2E tests; estimate 8-10 engineer-days (we can parallelize across two devs).

Realistic timeline:
- Patch & internal QA: 7 business days
- Staging E2E + re-run of the onboarding checklist: 5 business days
- Buffer for unexpected infra flakiness: 3 business days
=> ~3 weeks total.

Recommendation: 30-day extension is reasonable. I also recommend we provision a short-lived test cluster (I can spin one up for 5 days) so Tessera can validate without consuming their main sandbox credits. That would lower the credit top-up needed.

I've attached the onboarding checklist (poe-onboarding-checklist.xlsx) with suggested checklist items we should run after the patch.

—Elliot
Elliot Price
Senior SRE, Inference Runtime
redwood.ai

From: Rachel Ng <rachel@tessera.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, elliot_price@redwood.ai
Cc: Aiden Cole <aiden@tessera.ai>, procurement@tessera.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impact — request for short bridge and credits

Thanks, Jordan and Elliot — this all looks good.

Quick confirmation from our side:
- ETA: engineering expects to merge the patch by Nov 10 (we're on an accelerated mini-sprint) which aligns with the ~3 week window.
- Data: we'll continue to use synthetic/test records only in the sandbox (no customer PII).
- Credits: procurement confirmed they just need an approval email from Redwood to process an internal purchase if needed; however, the test cluster option is preferred so we only ask for a $750 top-up.

Aiden and I appreciate the quick turnaround. Jordan — if you can send a short approval email that covers the 30-day extension + $750 sandbox credit/top-up and the temporary test cluster, procurement will process any paperwork.

Best,
Rachel Ng
Engineering Lead, Tessera Labs

On Fri, Oct 30, 2026 at 03:04 PM jordan_blake@redwood.ai wrote:
> Rachel — thanks for the confirmation.
>
